lines.trans: Goodbye, although wait a minute.
Lena, maybe we should get married right now?
Vitya, have at least a little conscience.
Your daughter just ran away from the altar.
She will remember this with a smile.
She is a young and strong woman.
And I am no longer young.
We must treasure every minute of ours.
And savor every new moment.
Let us be together as husband and wife.

future, 1st person plural (auxiliary of the compound future)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

беречь.gloss: to take care of, to look after, to protect

meanings.en: to take care of, to look after, to protect
meanings.note: береги себя = take care of yourself

examples.text: Ну пока, друг, береги себя там!
examples.trans: Well, bye, pal, take care of yourself out there!

examples.text: Вот последняя банка, на, береги её.
examples.trans: Here's the last jar, take it and look after it.
We have to treasure every minute we have.

related.gloss: to be careful, to watch out

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

meanings.note: из-под венца = (run away) from the altar; идти под венец = to get married

examples.trans: Your daughter ran away from the altar.

examples.text: Они пошли под венец через месяц.
examples.trans: They got married a month later.

examples.text: Я этого не хочу. Но вспомни, у тебя сын болеет.
examples.trans: I don't want that. But remember, your son is ill.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: + dative of person + accusative of thing
imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

related.gloss: to hand in; to take (an exam)
to reach, walk as far as

meanings.note: irregular feminine declension with stem дочер-

examples.text: Простите, это собака дочери. Я с ней гуляю пока.
examples.trans: Sorry, it's my daughter's dog. I'm walking her for now.
I'm with my wife this evening.

examples.text: Но вечером я обещал быть с женой.
examples.trans: But I promised to be with my wife this evening.

examples.text: Твоя жена очень мудрая женщина. Ты её слушай.
examples.trans: Your wife is a very wise woman. You listen to her.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

из-под.gloss: from under; (of a box/bottle) formerly holding

meanings.note: коробка из-под шалфея = a sage box (that used to hold sage)

examples.text: В коробках из-под шалфея тоже нашли траву!
examples.trans: In the sage boxes they also found herbs!
The cat crawled out from under the sofa.

meanings.note: mostly in set phrases: иметь совесть, иметь право = to have the right; everyday 'I have' is у меня есть

examples.trans: You have the right to remain silent.

examples.text: Нина, имей совесть! Я вчера ради вас всё сделал.
examples.trans: Nina, have a heart! Yesterday I did everything for you.

examples.text: Аркаш, мне москвичи звонят каждый день. Может, всё-таки передумаем?
examples.trans: Arkasha, the people from Moscow call me every day. Maybe we should reconsider after all?

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?
I'll be there in ten minutes.

examples.text: Ладно, будь там. Через десять минут буду.
examples.trans: All right, stay there. I'll be there in ten minutes.

examples.text: Молодой человек, как на тест-драйв записаться?
examples.trans: Young man, how do I sign up for a test drive?

examples.text: Молодой человек, а как на тест-драйв записаться?
examples.trans: Young man, how do I sign up for a test drive?

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.
Nina, pour your husband a drink. We've got something to celebrate!

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: наш, наша, наше, наши; agrees with the noun

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I need to do a bit of work.

examples.text: Мы даём вам ещё немного времени.
examples.trans: We are giving you a little more time.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice

examples.text: Ну что, довольна? Теперь новую работу искать.
examples.trans: Well, happy now? Now I have to look for a new job.
I declare the court session closed.

examples.text: Она нашла нас на новом месте.
examples.trans: She found us at the new place.
That is it, she got really offended.
She is not answering her phone.

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!
examples.trans: Wait, Nina, you don't get it. It's shameful!

meanings.note: subject is a couple: мы поженимся; compare жениться (man), выйти замуж (woman)

examples.trans: Of course we'll definitely get married.

examples.text: Мы вернулись в Россию и поженились.
examples.trans: We came back to Russia and got married.

examples.text: Все думали даже, что они поженятся.
examples.trans: Everyone even thought they'd get married.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.note: сбежать из-под венца = to run away from the altar

examples.text: Да, он сбежал, чтобы спасти моего ребёнка.
examples.trans: Yes, he ran away to save my child.
Your daughter ran away from the altar.

examples.text: Ты думал, что легко сбежишь отсюда?
examples.trans: Did you think you'd escape from here easily?

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.en: strong, powerful (also used as a noun: the strong)

examples.text: Сильный ищет способ, а слабый ищет причину.
examples.trans: The strong man looks for a way, and the weak man looks for an excuse.
A strong wind was blowing outside.

examples.text: Надо заманить его на свою территорию. Там, где ты сильный.
examples.trans: You need to lure him onto your territory. Right where you are strong.

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

meanings.note: имей совесть! = have a heart! / shame on you!

examples.text: Нина, имей совесть! Я вчера ради вас всё сделал.
examples.trans: Nina, have a heart! Yesterday I did everything for you.

meanings.note: almost always the short form: я согласен (man), я согласна (woman)

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

examples.text: Все официанты готовы встречать гостей улыбкой.
examples.trans: All the waiters are ready to greet guests with a smile.

examples.text: У тебя мои глаза и улыбка.
examples.trans: You have my eyes and smile.

meanings.note: Дай хоть одну = give me just one.

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

хотя.gloss: even if, at least (with бы); although

meanings.note: нужно хотя бы поговорить = we need at least to talk

examples.text: Нужно хотя бы поговорить с ними.
examples.trans: We need at least to talk with them.

examples.text: Вы плохо поступили, но хотя бы совесть есть.
examples.trans: You acted badly, but at least you have a conscience.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
